caption: Planning feels like guesswork, but AI prompts can turn it into a repeatable process. This carousel lays out a five-step diagnose-build-check-refine workflow for prioritising work. Use the prompts weekly to keep projects on track and avoid bottlenecks. What task would you prioritise first this week? #AI #Productivity #Founders #Entrepreneurs

slides.title: Weak planning, wasted weeks
slides.body: Your plan misses priorities. I'll give five prompts to fix planning and accelerate work.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priorities
slides.body: Given task list: [input task list], output a ranked priority list with reasons for top items.

slides.title: 2. Define constraints
slides.body: From the diagnosed priorities, set constraints: max daily hours, deadlines, and energy limits. Output: constraint list.

slides.title: 3. Create plan
slides.body: Produce a concrete, time-bound plan: tasks in order, owners, timebox, and milestones. Output: task table.

slides.title: 4. Check feasibility
slides.body: Given constraints, validate deadlines and capacity. Output: feasibility verdict and adjustments.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Provide a reusable weekly planning ritual: inputs, prompts, cadence, and review. Output: 1-page workflow.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: A clear top-priority plan beats busywork. Save time by running these prompts weekly.
